description:
Concentration, up to 1 minute.

Choose a manufactured metal object within medium range. You cause the object to glow red-hot. Any creature in physical contact with the object takes 2d8 damage when you cast the spell. Once per round, beginning with your next turn, you may use a half action to cause this damage again.

Roll Lore to set the Difficulty. If a creature is holding or wearing the object and takes the damage from it, the creature must roll Fortitude against the Difficulty. On a failure, it drops the object if it can. If it doesn’t drop the object, all its skill checks are ill-favored for the next round.
name: Heat Metal
successes:
✨: +1d damage.

🌞: +2d damage.

💀: Another worn or carried metal object within medium range, chosen at random, becomes the target. Check a Condition.
